cc:Work.dc:title: JevBench v1.6.1, axis by axis
cc:Work.dc:description: Table of JevBench v1.6.1 scores for 11 rows: ten open-weights systems from the board's file and Jev 1.13.0 as a reference row, in alphabetical order, with six columns (overall, intelligence, sealed questions, calibration, speed, cost). Each cell is a plain value; the table has no shading or marks. Decisio 31B v0.8.0's values are overall 71.69, intelligence 70.4, sealed questions 73.3, calibration 88.7, speed 91.2, cost 51.7. The Decisio rows are the board's v0.8.0 entries: Decisio 31B v0.8.0 (71.69) and Decisio 12B v0.8.0 (68.17). The board's decisio v0.9.0 12B entry (67.76) is not among the rows shown.

g.text: Ten open-weights systems in alphabetical order and Jev 1.13.0 as a reference row; plain values, 0 to 100
Source: benchmarkheaven.com/api/jevbench/v1.6.1 (view A), read 2026-10-09, sha256 5cd8c1332226ea9c179883d2285c0d8b8cc593ae38f2645197364a7ddd9c83c1. Current standings: benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models.
The four axes have no published intervals; the composite shows its 95% interval in small text. A fixed set of systems, in alphabetical order, with no shading or marks.
The Decisio rows are the board's v0.8.0 entries (31B 71.69, 12B 68.17); the 12B's v0.9.0 entry (67.76) is not among these rows.
